gates.gate: P4-DB-001 clean migration/replay/seed and phase boundary
P4-FIX-001 isolated bilingual fixtures idempotently load and publish
P4-MAST-001 separate facets, immutable evidence, six skills and exact recompute
P4-ISO-001 direct DB negative owner/language/facet projection constraints
P4-TXN-001 projections/mistakes/evidence roll back together; replay/concurrency exact once
P4-REVIEW-001 candidate isolation, immutable selection, shared attempts, skip and expiry
P4-SUPPORT-001 reveal retains lapse/short due and cannot fabricate independent mastery
P4-COLL-001 curated/custom CRUD, cross-language rejection, deletion preserves learning
P4-RESET-001 explicit position/language reset, immutable history and unaffected Czech
P4-UI-001 Chromium EN/CS Review and collection journeys
P4-API-001 auth/CSRF, Review permissions and actual P4 HTTP contracts
P4-DB-002 introspection and clean database recreation

final_head_rule: Final containing commit must pass P1 push/PR, P2 PR, P3 PR and P4 push/PR on its exact head. artifacts/p4/acceptance-summary.json:tested_sha must equal checked-out HEAD and GITHUB_HEAD_SHA. Earlier green checkpoint is not acceptance of later code/metadata.
local_limits: No local Docker/PostgreSQL/Chromium; real runtime evidence executed on GitHub Actions.
